title: coap_config/coap_rangetest/coap_waypoints still call strnlen: same minimal-libc -Werror break as y0z0
description: Scope note from correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-y0z0 (which fixed coap_status.c only): strnlen is not declared by Zephyr's minimal libc under the 4.1.0 toolchain (implicit-function-declaration -Werror breaks any build pulling these files). Remaining call sites: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_config.c:138,237,620-624, coap_rangetest.c:469, coap_waypoints.c:95. They compile today only because ping_l2's config does not pull those translation units; the gateway/app builds that do will break identically. Fix: mirror y0z0's status_bounded_len memchr helper (or a shared coap-level helper) at each site; keep the >= sizeof(...) invalid-string semantics. Naturally bundled with the 2r8s/wgyl handler migrations that touch the same files.
